jobs.description: Senior Manager, Product Manager, Deposit Fraud Decisioning Lead At Capital One, we believe great products begin with a deep understanding of our customers. From our earliest days, we pioneered the use of predictive modeling to individually personalize credit card offers, turning the entire industry on its head. As we’ve grown bigger, we’ve found more and more ways to use technology and face-to-face conversations to understand the human problems associated with money and finances. In the Consumer Bank, we’ve combined this human-centered approach with our heritage of data-driven decision making to design, build and test our way to truly enabling financial experiences. We’ve challenged ourselves to spend less time planning, more time doing, and, above all else, to see the world through the eyes of our customers as they work to understand and manage their money. Are you passionate about improving the way people interact with their money? Are you driven by the delight you bring to customers? Do you keep asking, “why,” until you hit the root? It’s common to fall in love with solutions, but have you ever fallen in love with the problem? Do you have an opinion on whether shipping is more important than perfection? Do you have a healthy dose of skepticism for the impossible? If you’re nodding your head, then we want you! About the Team: At the heart of any bank account, customers move and manage their money—transferring money between their accounts, wiring money to purchase a home, and more. At the same time, bad actors are constantly evolving to scam or steal from our customers. Our mission is twofold: make it seamless for good customers to use their account day in, day out, while making it impossible for those bad actors to get in. To accomplish this, we build the intelligent data-driven brain behind those customer experiences, managing the policies, models, and data integrations that power our automated decisions. We also design empathetic, trust-building experiences for customers and associates when a decision requires a human touch. We are a team of strategists, builders, and customer advocates who thrive on solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, data, and human experience. Role Overview: The Deposit Fraud Decisioning Product Manager will focus on protecting customers from account takeover and scams in key customer experiences. This role will be responsible for working across engineering, business analysts, data science, and with partner teams to craft journeys that aim to perfectly predict the potential risk, and guide customers and associates after an automated decision flags them for risk. This is a highly collaborative role, who will work closely with product managers across Capital One in the Retail Bank and Enterprise teams, designers, engineers, data scientists, operations, and business partners to continue to evolve our strategy. On any given day in the Bank you’ll be: Empowered. Part of a team driving the bank’s omni-channel acquisitions strategy responsible for setting and delivering the decisioning and treatment framework to ensure our business is gaining profitable customers through both digital and digital-human interactions Learning constantly. Work deeply with customers, frontline associates, designers, technologists, analysts, marketers and data scientists to build cutting edge solutions Innovating relentlessly. Pushing big change by asking bold questions; starting small, testing, and learning your way to something dramatically better Sharing openly. Telling stories that change the way people think about building products and solving problems, and that illustrate the power of what software can do to make them even better Connecting creatively. Jump-starting a self-supporting community by sowing the right seeds, building the right tools, integrating the right off-the-shelf products, and just plain elbow grease Succeeding strategically. Solving the right problem and holding on the wrong one. jobs.description: Craft: UX & UI Job Description: We’re looking for a Senior Principal UX Designer to help transform the developer experience at King. This is a 6 month fixed-term maternity cover. You’ll work with our Build & Infrastructure teams as we reset King’s continuous integration (CI) orchestration. We’re modernising the foundations of our CI ecosystem while addressing years of accumulated complexity across its workflows. This is more than a technology transformation. It’s an opportunity to understand what our game teams need from CI, simplify critical workflows and create a developer ecosystem that helps teams build and deliver great games effectively. You’ll bring deep user research expertise and senior design leadership to the programme. Initially, you’ll lead a summative study of our current CI workflows, helping the team understand users’ pain points, behaviours and unmet needs. You’ll identify the outcomes and jobs to be done that should shape the future CI experience. You’ll then work closely with engineers, product partners and King’s game teams to translate those insights into clear, efficient CI workflows and coherent end-to-end journeys across our developer ecosystem. This role belongs to part of the Kingdom we call Shared Tech. The teams within Shared Tech work across all the technology that we use to power our live games, including data infrastructure, machine learning, payments infrastructure and the game engine itself. Your role within the Kingdom Define and lead research into King’s existing CI workflows, using appropriate qualitative and quantitative methods. Identify pain points, workarounds and unmet needs, translating your findings into prioritised outcomes and clearly articulated user stories, jobs to be done, or similar. Map current and future developer journeys across CI and the wider developer ecosystem. Work with engineers and game teams to design, prototype and evaluate intuitive, efficient CI workflows. Facilitate workshops that build shared understanding, explore solutions and align teams around priorities. Communicate complex systems and design decisions clearly, influencing initiative direction through evidence, systems thinking and constructive challenge. Help establish sustainable practices for continuing to learn from users as our CI ecosystem evolves. Skills and experience Must have Extensive experience as a senior UX, product or service designer, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact work through expertise and influence. Deep user research expertise, including planning and leading substantial studies and turning findings into product direction and practical design decisions. Strong interaction and workflow design skills, particularly for complex tools, systems or end-to-end user journeys. Experience applying jobs-to-be-done or comparable outcome-led frameworks. Confidence working closely with engineers and engaging with technical subject matter. Excellent facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to create alignment around competing needs and constraints. The ability to work independently, bring structure to ambiguity and balance user needs with technical and delivery considerations. Particularly valuable Experience designing developer tools, internal platforms or other products for technical users. Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery, build systems or software-development workflows. Experience with Jenkins, Buildkite or comparable CI/CD platforms. Clear priorities based on the outcomes users need to achieve, not simply the features of the existing system. Simpler, smoother and more coherent CI workflows. End-to-end developer journeys that work well across the wider King ecosystem. Strong collaboration between Build & Infrastructure teams and the game teams they support. A sustainable foundation for continuing to improve the CI experience. COMPANY OVERVIEW
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
POSITION SUMMARY
KKR is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to help bring AI into the daily work of teams across the firm. This is a hands-on engineering role with a builder's mindset: you are an embedded extension of the engineering team that works directly with investment teams to understand how their work gets done, then design, build, and ship production AI systems that improve it.
Your “customers” are internal: colleagues across private equity, credit, infrastructure, real estate, insurance and capital markets. You will sit with these teams and observe their workflows firsthand. You will identify where fragmented data, repetitive tasks, and manual handoffs slow high-value work, and translate ambiguous business challenges into well-defined technical problems. You will then own the solution end to end, from architecture, code, data integration, to evaluation, deployment, and adoption, in close partnership with your direct engineering teammates, product, AI, data, security, and platform colleagues.
The best solutions you build will not stay one-off. You will convert successful implementations into reusable skills, tools, agents, and workflow components that scale across teams and strengthen the firm’s broader AI platform. If you are an engineer who wants your code to shape how a leading global investment firm works, this role offers rare scope and impact.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Engage teams across KKR’s businesses to observe how work is delivered, going beyond documented requirements to understand information flows, decision points, and day-to-day realities.
Identify high-value opportunities where AI can remove bottlenecks, connect fragmented data, eliminate repetitive work, or improve the speed and quality of decisions.
Translate loosely defined business challenges into clear technical problem statements, solution architectures, and delivery plans.
Design, build, and ship production-grade AI applications, agents, integrations, and workflow automations using modern languages such as Python or TypeScript.
Connect structured and unstructured data across enterprise systems and make it reliably usable by AI-enabled applications through pipelines, retrieval systems, and well-designed interfaces.
Create, test, and maintain reusable AI skills, tools, prompts, connectors, evaluation frameworks, and workflow components that can be shared across teams and business units.
Establish rigorous evaluations and success metrics that measure accuracy, reliability, adoption, time saved, decision quality, risk reduction, and business impact.
Move rapidly from discovery to prototype to production while upholding high standards for security, data protection, privacy, compliance, reliability, and maintainability.
Decompose organic, often undocumented workflows into modular capabilities — data, decisions, actions, and controls — and determine where AI, deterministic software, or human judgment is the right tool.
Drive adoption through documentation, training, direct user feedback, and close, ongoing partnership with the teams you serve.
Convert successful high-touch implementations into repeatable engineering patterns and scalable platform capabilities, feeding insights into the firm’s broader AI roadmap.
Challenge conventional practices constructively, helping teams reimagine workflows rather than simply automating existing steps.
HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE BUSINESS AND TECHNOLOGY TEAMS
Forward Deployed Engineers and technology teams own the engineering side of AI enablement for business partners: architecture, integration, data pipelines, security implementation, and production operations.
Paired with a business-embedded AI Solutions counterpart, you will be in the room together from the first discovery conversation, and you will stay engaged together through deployment testing with users, measuring results, and iterating. Your job is to make sure what gets built solves the right problem, fits how people actually work, meets the firm's control requirements, and gets used. Along the way, you will also work with product owners, data teams, information security, and corporate functions such as legal and compliance, tailoring your communication to each audience.
QUALIFICATIONS
A strong software engineering foundation, with hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production systems — at least or equivalent demonstrated capability.
Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or comparable modern programming languages, with experience across APIs, cloud platforms, distributed systems, and enterprise integrations.
Practical experience building applications with large language models — including agents, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, and orchestration — and evaluating their behavior.
Facility with data: pipelines, databases, retrieval systems, and unstructured content, and the judgment to make imperfect enterprise data usable.
Genuine commercial curiosity and a strong desire to learn KKR’s businesses — how investments are evaluated, how decisions are made, and which outcomes matter.
Comfort operating in ambiguity: the ability to take a vague problem, ask good questions, uncover needs users may not initially articulate, and converge on a concrete solution.
The range to move fluidly between writing code, discussing architecture, observing workflows, and engaging senior business stakeholders.
Act as a conductor across a diverse set of stakeholders — including business teams, business-aligned product and engineering, AI platform product and engineering, and data operations — to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and drive projects forward to successful delivery.
A commitment to engineering quality — testing, observability, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices — even when moving quickly.
Clear communication and a collaborative, low-ego working style, with the ability to give and receive direct feedback.
Experience deploying AI or data-intensive systems in large enterprises or regulated environments.
Exposure to private markets, financial services, or other domains with complex, judgment-heavy workflows.
Experience partnering directly with senior business stakeholders to shape and deliver technical solutions.
A track record of turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms, frameworks, or internal products.
Experience with evaluation frameworks, observability tooling, or governance practices for LLM applications.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
AI solutions you built are running in production and used every day by the teams they were designed for.
Workflows you touched are measurably better — faster cycle times, higher-quality decisions, less manual effort, or lower operational risk.
Capabilities you created — skills, tools, agents, connectors, and evaluation frameworks — are reused by other teams and business units.
Business partners trust you as someone who understands their work and seek you out with their hardest problems.
The systems you ship are secure, reliable, well-evaluated, and maintainable long after launch.
Lessons from your deployments visibly shape the firm’s broader AI platform and roadmap.
